flows.description: Infection of susceptibles; force of infection λ(t) proportional to infectious individuals and β (homogeneous mixing).
Latent progression stage 1: E₁ → E₂ at rate σ.
Latent progression stage 2: E₂ → I₁ at rate σ.
Infectious progression stage 1: I₁ → I₂ at rate γ.
Recovery/removal: I₂ → R at rate γ.

parameters.description: Transmission rate parameter (rate at which new infections take place given a contact) used in force of infection λ(t) ∝ β * (infectious prevalence). Paper assumes homogeneous mixing.
Daily progression rate through latent stages: E₁→E₂ and E₂→I₁. Implies mean incubation/latent period d_L = 2*(1/σ). Treated as known from previous studies.
Daily progression rate through infectious stages: I₁→I₂ and I₂→R. Implies mean infectious period d_I = 2*(1/γ). Treated as known from previous studies.
Force of infection at time t. Text: proportional to number of infectious people and constant transmission rate β. (Population scaling not specified in extracted text; homogeneous mixing assumed.)
Initial susceptibility (fraction of population non-immune at start). Appears in parameter set Θ_T=(π, λ₀, ψ, σ, γ).
Initial infection rate / initial force of infection parameter used in early exponential growth re-parameterization (EGR).
Early exponential growth rate (EGR) parameter used to re-parameterize the transmission model under initial exponential growth assumption.
Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection (severity measure).
Mean delay from infection/exposure to ICU/HDU admission; waiting time modeled as Gamma distributed. Treated as known from previous studies.
Variance of delay from infection/exposure to ICU/HDU admission (Gamma waiting time). Treated as known from previous studies.
Negative Binomial dispersion parameter for weekly ICU/HDU admission counts (observation model).
